items.title: Handmade Indian Cotton Dress | Burgundy Leaf Block Print | Sustainable Artisan Label | M/L
items.description:
Beautiful handmade dress in brown colour with a cream leaf motif, which is a classic Indian block-print style. Handcrafted in Delhi by Anoshka Boutique, a homegrown label known for artisan-made, tailor-stitched pieces. Made from soft, breathable natural cotton, perfect for summer days.
Details:
Sleeveless A-line cut with a rounded neckline
Flattering, relaxed fit that skims the body
Side button detail
Hand block-printed leaf pattern
Natural cotton, sustainable and breathable

Note: cotton naturally creases (as shown) — a quick iron or steam and it's ready to go.
Size: M/L 
This best suits a bust of roughly 38 inch / 96 cm or smaller for a comfortable fit. I’m a 40 inch bust and it is very slightly snug on me there, which is the only reason I’m selling. Everything else fits lovely and loose. The A-line body is generous through the waist and hips.
Condition: Excellent

items.title: Indian Tunic Top | Peplum | Tie At Back | Size L
items.description:

items.title: Indian Cotton Maxi Skirt · Kalamkari Floral Print · Elasticated Waist · Boho Summer
items.description:
Stunning full-length Indian cotton skirt in a rich kalamkari-style floral print in deep burgundy, rust, tan and cream on a dark base. Beautifully detailed and full of movement. Breathable cotton.

Full A-line / flared cut — lovely twirl and drape

items.title: Bestseller Albert Camus The Stranger Nobel Prize Winner Vintage International Edition
items.description: An ordinary man is unwittingly drawn into a senseless murder on a sun drenched Algerian beach in this cornerstone of existentialist literature. Le Monde ranked it number one on its list of the 100 Books of the Century, and Camus explored through it what he called the nakedness of man faced with the absurd. This edition features Matthew Ward's acclaimed translation, praised by the Chicago Sun Times as making it our classic as well as France's. Camus won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1957. 4.03 stars on Goodreads. #existentialism #albertcamus #classicliterature

Ranked among the greatest novels ever written by millions of

spellbound.

#athousandssplendidssuns #khaledhosseini #booktok

items.title: can’t miss Russian Fyodor Dostoevsky The Brothers Karamazov Literary Masterpiece

#dostoevsky #russianliterature #penguinclassics
